operating_income.source: not found: operating income is not reported in the XBRL data (null in deskstack) for FY2023-FY2025. Not filled from memory. For reference only, pretax income plus interest expense would be 30,053 / 28,100 / 20,960, but that is not a filed EBIT.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: modest recovery after FY2025 revenue decline of 6.8% (189,031 vs 202,792), then roughly inflation-level growth; commodity prices not forecast.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption (no filed EBIT available): approximate mid-cycle margin, informed by a pretax-income-plus-interest proxy of about 11.1% for FY2025 (range 11.1%-15.0% over FY2023-25). Reviewer should confirm against the 10-K income statement.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: Damodaran US Oil/Gas (Integrated) effective tax rate 28.2% (betas dataset 2026-01-05).

wacc.source: Assumption. CAPM check: Rf 4.86% (US 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta ~0.31 (Damodaran cash-corrected unlevered 0.278, D/E 0.138) x ERP 4.46% = ~6.2% cost of equity, WACC ~5.7%. Judged too low for a commodity-exposed company (industry beta from only 4 firms), so 7.5% used.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: lowered to 1.5%, below inflation and the 4.86% risk-free rate, reflecting energy transition headwinds; also reduces terminal value share of EV (a 5-year explicit horizon makes TV-heavy valuation inherent).

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 50,699 (ltd_noncurrent 39,781 + debt_current 10,918) - cash 7,285 - STI 0; accession 0000093410-26-000078
